description: This file defines an abstract class ByteBuffer providing operations for reading and writing bytes, integers, and shorts with mechanisms for handling buffer state, including size, length, and overflow conditions.
published: byte[] get(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
int put(byte[] buf, int off, int len)

classes.name: ByteBuffer
classes.description: An abstract class providing byte buffer operations for reading and writing bytes, integers, and shorts, with support for buffer state management.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is empty by comparing length to zero.

methods.name: isFull
methods.description: Checks if the buffer is full by comparing length to size.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Abstract method to return the maximum capacity of the buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Abstract method to return the current amount of data in the buffer.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Abstract method to retrieve the next byte from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[] buf)
methods.description: Reads bytes into buf from the buffer.

methods.name: get(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
methods.description: Reads up to len bytes into buf starting at offset off.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Abstract method to insert a byte into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[] buf)
methods.description: Copies bytes from buf into the buffer.

methods.name: put(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
methods.description: Copies len bytes from buf starting at offset off into the buffer.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears the buffer, resetting its state.

methods.name: getInt
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 32-bit integer from the buffer.

methods.name: getShort
methods.description: Reads a little-endian 16-bit short from the buffer.

methods.name: putInt
methods.description: Puts a little-endian 32-bit integer into the buffer.

calls: put(byte[] buf, int off, int len)
